_doc: The 6 mm slot of the 20 mm series as European sellers stock it ("B-type", made to match Bosch Rexroth's), for unbranded stock: the figures one named seller's CAD outline gives (KJN), agreeing with a second seller's drawing where that prints one (Dold Mechatronik). Stock sold from the Far East as "2020 EU standard" has another slot under the same name: 6.2 between the lips, 11 under them and 6.1 deep (Spool3D's drawing). Every figure is community: measure the bar you have. The drawn slot leaves out the small step at the mouth and the V groove in the floor.
name: slot-6

opening.rule: Between the lips: 6 in KJN's outline, "6,0 + 0,3 mm" at Dold. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
opening.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part KJN992888 (20x20), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ALUMINIUM%20PROFILE/6mm%20Slot/20X20_KJN992888.dxf

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the lip's underside, in KJN's outline (Dold dimensions none). Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
lip_thickness.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part KJN992888 (20x20), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ALUMINIUM%20PROFILE/6mm%20Slot/20X20_KJN992888.dxf

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips, in KJN's outline. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
cavity_width.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part KJN992888 (20x20), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ALUMINIUM%20PROFILE/6mm%20Slot/20X20_KJN992888.dxf

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the floor: KJN's outline and Dold's drawing agree. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
cavity_depth.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part KJN992888 (20x20), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ALUMINIUM%20PROFILE/6mm%20Slot/20X20_KJN992888.dxf

floor_width.rule: Width of the flat floor in KJN's outline, reached by 45 degree flanks. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
floor_width.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part KJN992888 (20x20), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ALUMINIUM%20PROFILE/6mm%20Slot/20X20_KJN992888.dxf

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees, in KJN's outline
flank_angle.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part KJN992888 (20x20), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ALUMINIUM%20PROFILE/6mm%20Slot/20X20_KJN992888.dxf

nut_family.rule: Sold with "slot 6" or "B-type 6" nuts; a nut made for one seller's slot is not promised in another's
